_readme: 本文件由 Skill 工作台自动生成（勾了「上板」的技能 + works-extras.json 里的系统/agent 作品）。别手改——下次工作台保存会覆盖。网站项目从这里读取渲染作品板。tally=板上作品数，inventory=库存总量（含未上板），页面数字钩子二选一。

works.name: Lindsey Studio
works.desc: Personal multi agent AI studio: 14 specialized agents, dispatch ticket orchestration, goal gated acceptance, scheduled content pipelines and a permission system. It runs my daily operations end to end.

works.name: ERP System
works.desc: A local ERP dashboard for the whole company in 1 place: accounting with invoices, payables and expense approvals, inventory and order fulfillment, vendor payment runs, a sales pipeline and a ticket queue. Live demo on placeholder data.

works.name: Marketing Agency System
works.desc: An operating and reporting system built in house for a marketing agency that runs many client accounts: daily and weekly reports on cost, GMV, ROI and orders per account, a live board that refreshes on a schedule, and automated data pulls, all running locally at 0 token so client numbers stay in house.

works.name: Property Agent CRM
works.desc: A WhatsApp follow up CRM built for property agents: it works a lead list, sends scheduled follow ups, reads each reply to score intent, writes the status back, and hands anything it cannot answer to a human with an alert. Runs locally and answers only from an approved knowledge base.

works.name: ad-video-product-check
works.desc: Checks a TikTok or Douyin selling video against the real product and flags mismatches in size, texture and claims, with evidence frames and a verdict.

works.name: geo-audit-suite
works.desc: Audits how a site shows up in AI answers and search, scoring GEO and AEO visibility with a chart and a fix list.

works.name: 视频拆解
works.desc: Breaks any TikTok or Douyin video into a clean watermark free file, full transcript, on screen text and key frames from one link.
